clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked away along the northern cliffside of Thousand Needles, the Weathered Nook is a secluded cleft and shelter perched high above the canyon floor. Overlooking the vast sea of stone spires, it serves as a modest home and retreat for solitary tauren dwellers seeking quiet contemplation away from bustling settlements.

Carved into the sheer sandstone wall north of Freewind Post, the Weathered Nook is easily missed by travelers passing along the canyon basin below. A natural ramp winds up the cliff face, leading to a sheltered ledge and cave out of the prevailing winds. Rather than housing a military outpost or large settlement, the nook serves as a humble homestead for solitary wanderers like Dorn Plainstalker and Prate Cloudseer, offering safety, seclusion, and a sweeping view across the windswept needle plateaus.
